structure.what_is_said: Butter yellow is popular but timeless and versatile. I love it as a top: cardigans, tank tops, fitted vests, cotton and cashmere sweaters with white bottoms. White shorts = casual daytime; white linen pants = more sophisticated. Skirts and dresses with gold jewelry and woven accessories. Buttery yellow adds warmth, white keeps it crisp. Feminine, elegant, so chic.

structure.what_is_said: Styled many ways: casual brunch, shopping or a sophisticated event. The beauty lies in the play of contrast: striped tops, a striped sweater over your shoulders, a white polo with a black collar. Simple details make an outfit sophisticated. Also great with linen, tailored pieces, flowy skirts and summer dresses. Crisp; the simplest combinations make the biggest impact.

structure.what_is_said: Finally, I'll leave one of my favorite stylistic techniques - monochrome
structure.how_it_is_shown: WHITE card '7. Monochromatic' black script

structure.what_is_said: Monochrome: shades of one colour for a cohesive look. A cream base with light browns; a rich burgundy look with matching shoes; a light blue shirt with denim. It looks refined and intentional, not overdone. Complete with elegant sunglasses, layered jewellery or minimalist accents. Timeless, the easiest way to a quiet luxurious aesthetic.
